verdict.rationale: Pomelo is a card-issuing and payments API platform, and such a platform could plausibly offer scheduled or recurring operations, so the axis applies. Nothing in the evidence pack documents a way to schedule recurring jobs or workflows. The credit-lifecycle, webhook-notification and MCP items describe other capabilities and do not cover user-defined recurring schedules.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can schedule recurring jobs or workflows
